scope: iPhone app only: 415 pull requests merged into main since 8 October (KST), 170 of them change app code, and 97 change how the app feels (motion, touches, scrolling, launch, tabs, loading). Web, server, CI, wording-only and settings-only changes are left out. Before is main and after is the change, each from its own recorded proof, copied as written; most proofs ran on an iOS simulator, not a phone. A merged change is not yet in a build.
